concerns.text: The plan suggests validating 'disorder-correlation signals' against 'bulk RNA-seq time courses'. This is a methodological mismatch: GRNBoost2 (and GRN inference generally) requires cell-to-cell variance to determine edge weights. Bulk RNA-seq provides population averages, making it impossible to re-infer the network topology or validate 'rewiring events' using the same logic. Validation must either use an independent single-cell cohort or pivot the validation metric to expression-level correlation (e.g., differential expression of hubs) rather than topological enrichment.
